tour.title: This is zafyros, from the inside.
tour.s1title: Your whole net worth, in one place
tour.s1body: Upload statements from your accounts and cards, and zafyros aggregates them into a clear Overview: how much you have in total and how it's evolving month to month — no bank connection required.
tour.s1alt: Screenshot of zafyros' Overview screen: total net worth aggregated from several accounts and its evolution over time.
tour.s2body: Analysis shows income, expenses and monthly balance at a glance, with the month-by-month trend and a breakdown by category — so you can make better decisions without reviewing transaction by transaction.
tour.s2alt: Screenshot of zafyros' Analysis screen: monthly income and expenses, monthly trend and spending breakdown by category.
tour.s3title: Every transaction, classified on its own
tour.s3body: Your own rules and a system that already recognizes thousands of merchants classify every transaction you import. You only fix the odd one out, never classify by hand.
tour.s3alt: Screenshot of zafyros' Transactions screen, with transactions already classified by category automatically.

steps.title: From statement to control in a minute.
steps.s1body: Download the CSV your online bank already offers. Nothing else needed from your bank.
steps.s2body: Drag and drop. We detect duplicates and transfers between your accounts automatically.
steps.s3body: Dashboards, global position and analysis up to date. Never touch a spreadsheet again.

security.title: Your data never leaves your control.
security.sub: Most finance apps ask for permanent access to your bank. We don't. Ever. You decide what you upload and when — and you can wipe it all in one click.
security.s1d: No connection to your bank. We never ask for a username or password.
security.s2d: Your statements travel and are stored encrypted. Only you see them.
security.s3d: Export or delete all your information whenever you want, no questions asked.
